grammar.limits: Mechanical checks complement the recorded primary-image and linguistic review; coordinator must still reconcile every assigned task and learner/key text.

decisions: All46 Cook IV16–17/V18 prompts are preserved. Detailed reinspection repaired provisional transcription errors in IV17.13 on (ofer), IV17.14 Ye, IV17.17 reference154.c and V18.10 bringst. These are audit repairs, not changes to Cook. The cumulative numbered crosswalk is295 assigned/349 deferred/0 excluded.

The92 tasks comprise8 form tasks,12 analyses,11 controlled compositions,15 reading tasks and46 Cook items. Fourteen translated examples and the59-word fisherman account are explicitly new teaching material. Actual public and required-output sequences have ordered form/sense bindings and separately audited constructions.

The exact Bede metals/jet span is35 lexical words plus one punctuation dash, p139/PDF155 lines1–4. The sea rescue is195 words, pp142–143/PDF158–159, from editorial142.8 through143.14. Both retain complete notes:32 attached notes and the referenced142 note7. Prior context is separate English editorial help.

Direct source inspection repaired næddran, nafogār and the Latin evasionis reading. The source copper spelling āres remains separate from earlier selected ǣr. Source periphrases, shifted lexical senses and larger constructions remain visibly supported. The final forgiefen means given/granted.

Purpose normally takes subjunctive and asserted result indicative. Cook’s optative curse is not a universal result rule. Temporal viewpoint, admitted concessive fact, open conditions and contrary-present contexts are distinct; no conjunction-to-mood transformation or broad tense-sequence rule is assigned.

The complete61 systems contain826 cells. The coordinator independently reconstructed all728 nominal/adjectival cells:388 literal and340 derived from exact printed models and diagnostic stems. The98 verb cells are literal. New exceptional patterns remain complete literal tables;38 matrices and38 lexical diagnostic rows provide all routes.

Bæð/geat vowel changes, seolh h-loss/lengthening, sumer retention and winter syncope are taught with their complete systems. Stille has its own literal tables because stilne cannot follow an unqualified smylte substitution. Cook40§59 directly supports stillu and the selected adjective-in-e system.

Sunne was absent from the actual prior register and is now explicitly taught with its full weak-feminine system. Sunne/mōna astronomical singular senses and mass/abstract noun plurals keep their stated scopes. Hǣlend has four proper-title singular cells; title/name apposition is separately taught for Cook18.1.

Seven full indicatives, five present/past participle base pairs, the gewītan commands and scēawian infinitives are assigned. The inflected scēawian infinitive retains recognition scope. Three unnecessary plural-participle systems were removed: actual Unit7 already licenses bare plural predicates, and current tasks use that established frame.

Scęððan selects the evidenced weak system while acknowledging strong variants. The coordinator directly inspected Cook71–72 and BT830b for the weak preterite and dative government. Additional lexical frames, including catch+accusative, obey+dative, put-into, approach and the selected comparison, require their own evidence and teaching records.

Substantival eall is bound to the selected neuter singular everything or masculine plural persons; bare strong genitives naming dead/living people, personal superlative address and mā with verbal comparison have explicit scopes. Familiar attributive morphology alone did not supply these constructions.

The final grammar sweep adds explicit article-plus-weak righteous-person and nālæs hōlunga negative-phrase scopes. Source task dependencies were refreshed before sealing; no broader negative-concord system follows.

Five Cook helps keep give-to-drink, four thousand men, born, nis and the plural negative auxiliary available. Twenty-one source helps support the two authentic extracts. Exact ðurh has a single supplied source identity, distinct from selected productive þurh; duplicate provisional identities were removed.

All earlier identities, surfaces, analyses, source spellings, evidence and milestones remain preserved. Explicit promotions record new contextual analyses separately, including formerly supplied obliques and participle citations. No teaching milestones are inherited from the archived course.

The source editor and designer prepared independent private translations from actual Old English; the coordinator also saved a source-first witness. The grammar analyst has read no private answer files and remains reserved to solve all actual learner tasks before key access. A committed contract precedes separate learner and key authorship.
